people.name: Rahab
people.line: A Canaanite woman who helped the Israelite spies in Jericho

translations.web: By faith, Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
translations.bsb: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies in peace, did not perish with those who were disobedient.
translations.kjv: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
translations.asv: By faith Rahab the harlot perished not with them that were disobedient, having received the spies with peace.
